pr_title: eth: added trace_call to trace on top of arbitrary blocks
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/issues/20515


The `debug_traceCall` method lets you run an `eth_call` on top of a given block. The block can be specified either by hash or by number. It takes the same input object as a eth_call.
It returns the same output as `debug_traceTransaction`. A tracer can be specified as a third argument, similar to `debug_traceTransaction`.

`Object` - The transaction call object
- `from`: `DATA`, 20 Bytes - (optional) The address the transaction is sent from.
- `to`: `DATA`, 20 Bytes - The address the transaction is directed to.
- `gas`: `QUANTITY` - (optional) Integer of the gas provided for the transaction execution. eth_call consumes zero gas, but this parameter may be needed by some executions.
- `gasPrice`: `QUANTITY` - (optional) Integer of the gasPrice used for each paid gas
- `value`: `QUANTITY` - (optional) Integer of the value sent with this transaction
- `data`: `DATA` - (optional) Hash of the method signature and encoded parameters. For details see Ethereum Contract ABI in the Solidity documentation

See also https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API

| Client  | Method invocation                 |
|:-------:|-----------------------------------|
| Go      | `debug.TraceCall(args ethapi.CallArgs, blockNrOrHash rpc.BlockNumberOrHash, config *TraceConfig) (*ExecutionResult, error)` |
| Console | `debug.traceCall(object, blockNrOrHash, [options])`                   |
| RPC     | `{"method": "debug_traceCall", "params": [object, blockNrOrHash, {}]}`     |

### Example
```
> debug.traceCall(null, "0x0")
{
  failed: false,
  gas: 53000,
  returnValue: "",
  structLogs: []
}
```
```
> curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST  localhost:8545 --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"debug_traceCall","params":[null, "pending"],"id":1}'
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"gas":53000,"failed":false,"returnValue":"","structLogs":[]}}
```

issue_context.title: Trace a call without sending the transaction
issue_context.body:
Would be great if there was an API that allowed tracing transactions while they are still pending, or one that allowed tracing an arbitrary transaction against the latest block like Parity does https://wiki.parity.io/JSONRPC-trace-module#trace_call

Is this something on the roadmap?

review_comments: This API will return the error if the specified state is not existent(e.g. the state is pruned). In the other trace APIs we will try to "reconstruct" the proper state for tracing. I think we should do the same thing?
Yep, did it so that if StateAndHeaderByNumberOrHash fails, I try to recreate the state
